notes: Exalted: The Fair Folk supplied and intake in progress. 60 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/fair-folk/inventory/: the character-creation overview (split into separate common- and noble-raksha rows), the four base castes (Diplomat/Entertainer/Warrior/Worker), the twelve named noble hybrid castes, the five Graces (Cup/Ring/Staff/Sword/Heart) with their forging rules, the Bedlam mechanic (the raksha's Limit-Trait analog) including all four Virtue-specific Curses, the five new Backgrounds (Birth/Freehold/Gossamer/Retinue/Style), the altered Backgrounds (Artifact/Familiar/Manse/Backing-Contacts-Influence) and the excluded ones (Followers/Resources), the core signature mechanics (Wyld-damage immunity, Craft (Glamour), Wyld Stunts/Bonuses, Gossamer-and-Glamour, Mutation, Shaping Actions/Reality Shaping, Shaping Combat basics, Oaths, Cold-Wrought Iron), and now two of Chapter Five's five per-Grace Charm trees in full: the 14-Charm Heart Grace tree (Nirguna -- Name/Bedlam-Influencing/Dodge/Resistance Charms) and the 12-Charm Staff Grace tree (Nirvikalpa -- the Laughing Monster Style combat tree plus the Society-Forging Charms tree). Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. The Cup, Ring and Sword Grace Charm trees, the universal Assumption-type Charm tree, Glamour Sorcery/Wyld Artifacts/Adjurations/Behemoths, an apparent unreviewed sixth 'Way' Grace, and Chapter One/Two/Six/Seven's setting, Mountain Folk and Storytelling material are not yet inventoried. Locked pending the remaining inventory, schema/rules/creator/editor implementation, and passing tests across all five planned families.
